title: Conflux: Preventing Privilege Escalation with Principal Contexts and System-Level Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2611.08768v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: LLM agents combine information from multiple principals while acting externally. We formalise privilege escalation (PE) as the system-level security objective: an action may proceed only if every principal that influenced it would allow it. Model-level defences remain probabilistic, so enforcement must sit outside model judgement. We present Conflux, a principal-context defence. Its kernel, ITES, derives authority from provenance and the organisation's existing access-control system and intersects the permissions of every influencing principal. We prove a conditional authority-confinement theorem: under complete mediation, no-laundering provenance, a known non-empty decision context, fresh permission checks, and action binding, the kernel admits no action that escalates privilege with respect to any recorded influencing principal. The theorem covers the represented value-influence fragment; control influence from tool, branch,

translated_title: Conflux：利用主体上下文与系统级评估防止权限提升
translated_abstract: LLM 智能体在对外执行操作时会整合来自多个主体的信息。我们将权限提升（PE）形式化为一个系统级安全目标：一个操作只有在所有影响它的主体都允许该操作时才能继续执行。由于模型级防御本质上仍是概率性的，因此强制执行机制必须置于模型判断之外。我们提出了 Conflux，一种基于主体上下文的防御机制。其内核 ITES 从来源信息（provenance）和组织现有的访问控制系统中推导权限，并对所有影响主体的权限求交集。我们证明了一个条件性的权限约束定理：在完全中介、来源不可洗白、决策上下文已知且非空、权限检查保持新鲜以及操作绑定的条件下，内核不会允许任何相对于任何已记录影响主体而言构成权限提升的操作。该定理涵盖所表示的值影响片段；来自工具、分支的控制影响……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出 Conflux 防御系统，通过主体上下文机制在系统层面（而非概率性的模型层面）对所有影响主体的权限求交集，从形式上证明可防止 LLM 智能体发生权限提升。
